subject: STAT101
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. For English, high-view, reputable channels like The Organic Chemistry Tutor and Simple Learning Pro were prominent. For Arabic, a mix of university-level lectures and highly popular foundational videos were chosen to best address student needs. All selections passed the strict quality and relevance gates.

coverage.note: Only one candidate was eligible after applying relevance and view count gates.
Selected a highly-viewed foundational video as it provides a comprehensive step-by-step guide covering all aspects of the topic.

videos.title: What Is And How To Use Chebyshev's Theorem And The Empirical Rule Formula In Statistics Explained
videos.filter_reason: This concise video directly explains and provides examples for both rules, making it ideal for comparing them.

videos.title: Z-Scores, Standardization, and the Standard Normal Distribution (5.3)
videos.filter_reason: With exceptional view count and a perfectly titled, comprehensive explanation, this is a top-tier resource for the topic.

videos.title: How To Make Box and Whisker Plots
videos.filter_reason: A highly popular and comprehensive tutorial that covers all necessary steps: creating the plot, finding quartiles, IQR, and identifying outliers.

videos.title: How To Find The Interquartile Range & any Outliers - Descriptive Statistics
videos.filter_reason: This video clearly explains how to calculate quartiles to find the IQR, directly addressing the core calculation aspect of the topic.

videos.title: How to compare two different data sets using Coefficient of variation (CV)?
videos.filter_reason: A concise and direct explanation of how to use the Coefficient of Variation to compare different datasets, which is the key concept.

videos.title: Emperical rule & Chebyshev's theorem | شرح
videos.filter_reason: This was the only eligible candidate that clearly covers both the Empirical Rule and Chebyshev's theorem together.

videos.title: The Standard Value | الدرجة المعيارية
videos.filter_reason: This video has high views and its description specifically mentions using z-scores to compare distributions, addressing the main student challenge.

videos.title: التمثيل بالصندوق وطرفية للصف الثاني متوسط الفصل الدراسي الثاني
videos.filter_reason: Its massive view count indicates a very clear and effective step-by-step explanation of the entire process of creating a boxplot.

videos.title: الربيعات والعشيرات والمئينات (بيانات غير مبوبة) | 2021
videos.filter_reason: A highly relevant and popular video that focuses specifically on calculating quartiles, deciles, and percentiles for ungrouped data.

videos.title: Coefficient of Variation, Relative Dispersion or Relative Variance معامل التغاير، التشتت النسبي
videos.filter_reason: A clear, well-viewed explanation of the concept of coefficient of variation and its use as a measure of relative dispersion.
